assignments.node_id: ימלא גרונם, על־ידי רקודין, או על־ידי פדיון
assignments.reason: This eitza node describes the practical method: 'fill their throats through dancing or through pidyon (monetary redemption).' By essential nature, dancing (rikudin) is the movement of the legs (רגלים), and pidyon operates through money (ממון) which IS pillars (עמודים) which IS legs — all Package 2 concepts. The Torah states (line 4): 'through dancing... that is, he dances, and thereby expels the external forces from there' — the 'there' being the legs/heels domain of Package 2. The action takes place IN the lower-limb domain, making Package 2 its essential home.

assignments.node_id: להמתיק הדינים, על־ידי שרשם, שהוא יין המשמח
assignments.reason: This eitza node describes the goal and mechanism: 'to sweeten the judgments through their root, which is the joyful wine.' Although דינים (judgments) belongs to Package 2, the essential nature of this node is the ROOT that sweetens — שרשם שהוא יין המשמח — which IS Binah, the core of Package 1. The Torah states (line 9): 'judgments are not sweetened except through their root, and the root of judgments is in Binah.' The dominant concept here is the holy source doing the sweetening, not the judgments being sweetened.

This eitza node is the phrase 'holy enthusiasm, called the joyful wine.' Its component concepts — התלהבות שבקדושה and יין המשמח — are both already assigned to Package 1 (יין המשמח as a core bechina node, התלהבות שבקדושה via additions). The phrase itself describes a bechina identity (נקרא = 'is called') between two Package 1 members. Its essential nature is entirely within the holy-Binah-wine domain.

This eitza node means 'the firstborn-rights are sweetened.' The בכורות (firstborn blessings) are explicitly identified in the Torah as שרש הבכורה (root of the firstborn), a core Package 1 bechina node. Line 2 states: 'the root of the firstborn is called wine... and this is the joyful wine.' The sweetening of the firstborn-rights is the activation/fulfillment of Package 1's essential nature — the holy root of Binah reclaiming the blessing. The result (sweetened firstborn) belongs to the same essential domain as its source.
